name: egygenerator-task
description: Full-stack EgyGenerator task: NestJS API (server) + React client (client)

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && node scripts/setup-env.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
